title: lolium multiflorum var. lepturoides
intro: Lolium multiflorum var. lepturoides, commonly known as Italian ryegrass, is a perennial grass species native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its potential to improve cognitive function, boost energy levels, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Italian ryegrass are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic agent. The bioactive constituents of Lolium multiflorum var. lepturoides include flavonoids, saponins, and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
